source_independence_rules: A catalog page and the object it describes are one source root unless independent provenance exists.
A government assessment and a later report quoting it do not count as two independent confirmations.
Translations of the same text do not count as independent historical witnesses.
Partisan and official sources remain admissible as primary evidence of messaging or institutional position, not automatic evidence that all claims within are true.
next_gate: Resolve item-level rights and immutable retrieval targets; hash only stable openly retrievable source bytes, otherwise store metadata/source receipts without mirroring.
